name: guidejar
description: Connect your Guidejar workspace to create, update, and search guides and help articles

interface.longDescription: Connect your Guidejar workspace to create, update, and search guides and help articles
defaultPrompt: Write a step-by-step guide on processing a vendor invoice.
What's our month-end close checklist? Check our guides.
Add a step to our invoice approval guide for matching the PO number.

positive.description: Create a guide with browser screenshots
positive.prompt: Create a Guidejar guide on creating a project and adding a task with a due date in Todoist. Use the signed-in test account, perform the steps in your browser, and include screenshots. Return the guide link.
positive.expected_behavior: Performs the Todoist workflow using available browser tools, captures screenshots of key steps, uploads the image bytes successfully to the URLs returned by get_upload_url, and creates a guide in the test workspace with ordered instructions and the uploaded screenshots attached to the relevant steps. Returns a working guide link. A fallback without screenshots does not pass this case.

positive.prompt: How do I create a project and add a task with a due date in Todoist? Check my Guidejar guides.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Todoist guide created in positive test 1, summarizes its steps, and links to the guide.

positive.description: Add an FAQ to an existing guide
positive.prompt: Add an FAQ to my Todoist guide explaining how to change a task’s due date.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds the requested FAQ about changing a task’s due date while preserving all existing steps, screenshots, and unrelated FAQs. A follow-up get_guide may verify the saved update.

positive.description: Browse the contents of a folder
positive.prompt: List the guides in the Onboarding folder in my Guidejar workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the guides and articles directly inside the Onboarding folder, with titles and links. Content in subfolders isn't included.

positive.description: Turn rough notes into a help article
positive.prompt: Create a Guidejar help article from these notes: invoices need a PO number, the finance lead approves them, and payments go out on the 15th and 30th.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a help article that covers the PO requirement, who approves invoices and the two payment dates, and returns a link to it. It doesn't add policies that aren't in the notes.

negative.description: General how-to question that doesn't mention the user's own guides. Answer normally without invoking any Guidejar tools.
negative.prompt: How do I schedule an email in Gmail?

negative.description: User wants a draft to use elsewhere, not saved to Guidejar. Return a draft in chat without invoking any Guidejar tools.
negative.prompt: Draft an SOP for onboarding a new vendor that I can paste into a doc.

negative.description: Asks to find a document stored in another tool, not in Guidejar. Do not invoke Guidejar tools; use the appropriate connected drive search if available, or ask how to access the shared drive.
negative.prompt: Find the expense policy in our shared drive.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not support payments or purchases. An existing Guidejar account with a paid subscription is required. Subscription management occurs separately on the Guidejar website.

publication.release_notes: 0.1.6: Add the review video, align positive test cases with the recorded Todoist workflow, and clarify browser, screenshot, and upload capability checks and fallbacks.
